title: 〜に先立って / 〜に先立ち
meaning: prior to, in advance of, ahead of (a major event)
simpleExplanation: 〜に先立って means "before X, as preparation for it". X is an important event (opening, departure, construction, a match), and the action before it is something done in advance: an announcement, a check, a ceremony. It is more formal than 〜前に and implies that the earlier action is a deliberate preliminary step.
whenUsed: News, announcements, business documents: 開店に先立ち / 工事に先立って. The noun-modifying form に先立つ + N (に先立つ説明会) appears in headlines. In conversation people simply say 〜の前に.
formation: Noun (event) + に先立って / に先立ち
Verb (dictionary form) + に先立って (出発するに先立って)
Noun + に先立つ + Noun (工事に先立つ説明会)
Typical events: 開店・開催・出発・工事・発売・会議

steps.ja: 開店する前に、セールが行われる
steps.en: before opening, a sale is held (plain)

steps.ja: 開店に先立って、記念セールが行われる
steps.en: ahead of the opening, a commemorative sale is held (formal, a planned preliminary)

steps.ja: 開店に先立つ記念セール
steps.en: the commemorative sale preceding the opening (noun-modifying)

examples.ja: 開店に先立って、記念セールが行われる。
examples.reading: かいてんにさきだって、きねんセールがおこなわれる。
examples.en: Prior to the store opening, a commemorative sale will be held.
examples.note: A commemorative sale scheduled ahead of the opening: a planned preliminary.

examples.ja: 出発に先立ち、荷物の確認をした。
examples.reading: しゅっぱつにさきだち、にもつのかくにんをした。
examples.en: Before departure, I checked the luggage.
examples.note: に先立ち: written variant; checking luggage is preparation for departure.

examples.ja: 工事に先立つ説明会が開かれた。
examples.reading: こうじにさきだつせつめいかいがひらかれた。
examples.en: An information session was held ahead of the construction.
examples.note: に先立つ + noun: an information session preceding construction.

examples.ja: 試合に先立って、両チームの選手が握手を交わした。
examples.reading: しあいにさきだって、りょうチームのせんしゅがあくしゅをかわした。
examples.en: Before the match, the players of both teams shook hands.
examples.note: A ceremonial act that precedes the main event.

examples.ja: 新製品を発売するに先立ち、モニター調査を実施した。
examples.reading: しんせいひんをはつばいするにさきだち、モニターちょうさをじっしした。
examples.en: Prior to releasing the new product, we conducted a monitor survey.
examples.note: Dictionary-form verb + に先立ち in business writing.

similarGrammar.difference: Neutral "before"; usable for anything. に先立って implies a formal preliminary to a major event.
"At the time of" the event itself, not before it.
"Along with / as a consequence of": the second thing happens together with or after the first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 寝るに先立って、歯を磨く。
commonMistakes.why: Daily routines are too trivial for に先立って; use 前に.

commonMistakes.wrong: 開店したに先立って、セールを行った。
commonMistakes.right: 開店に先立って、セールを行った。
commonMistakes.why: Use the noun or the dictionary form; never the past form.

commonMistakes.wrong: 工事に先立ってお知らせ (as a heading)
commonMistakes.right: 工事に先立つお知らせ / 工事に先立ってのお知らせ
commonMistakes.why: Before a noun use に先立つ (or に先立っての).

usageNotes: The following clause is usually preparation, notice, or ceremony: 説明会, 準備, 確認, 発表.
に先立ち is the written or news form; に先立って is fine in formal speech.
先立つ also appears in the idiom 先立つもの (money needed first).
jlptTips: If the sentence describes a preparatory step before a formal event, に先立って fits; if the action happens at the event itself, に際して fits.
Verb form check: dictionary form only.
In 並べ替え, に先立つ + noun is a single chunk.
